title: Disable Structures
description: Disable generation of select structures through a config file.
body:
This mod let's you prevent chosen structures from generating in your world. Configuration is done through a config file (**structurecontrol.cfg**) in the config folder. By default no structure will be disabled. All vanilla structures are supported: 

- Desert Pyramid
- Jungle Temple
- Witch Hut
- Village
- Mineshaft
- Nether Fortress
- Stronghold
